branding_admin.title: Platform branding
branding_admin.lead: The platform logo and browser icon, shown on sign-in pages, the home page, the clinic app and the admin. Clinics that chose their own icon keep it on their pages.
branding_admin.preview_sub: How the logo shows in the sidebar and on sign-in pages.
branding_admin.images_sub: PNG, JPG or WebP — compressed automatically to WebP. Icon: a square PNG or ICO (kept as sent).

h.logo: Replaces the built-in mark. A wide logo with a transparent background works best.
h.logo_dark: Optional: a light version shown in dark mode.
h.favicon: Shown in the browser tab. 512×512 is best.

branding_admin.remove: Delete this image and go back to the default
branding_admin.show_name: Show the name “{name}” next to the logo
branding_admin.show_name_help: Turn off when the name is part of the logo.
branding_admin.invalid: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image (or ICO for the icon).
branding_admin.too_big: The image is larger than 1 MB.
branding_admin.invalid_one: The file for “{what}” is not an accepted image. Nothing was saved.
